features.name: Teleportal multipliers

review:
The original space-fruit game: an avocado, plum, pomegranate, lemon and passionfruit land from another planet onto BGaming's Bonanza engine. Wins clear and the reels refill, so one spin can chain into several wins, and the fruits' spaceship is the scatter.

In free spins a teleportal throws out a random multiplier from 2x to 100x and applies it to the whole refill sequence. High volatility, 15,000x max, 95.97% RTP. The bonus is a long wait – around once every 395 spins on average. Same bones as Bonanza Billion, just sillier and more fun to look at.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus is rare (about 1 in 395 spins on average)
